files.note: Read the whole automatic pull request path: name/content secret shapes (UTF-16, NUL bytes, batching), the fence, default-branch and upstream gates, index.lock handling, staged-blob and commit-range scans, and the push guards. The fail-closed rules hold; found no provable defect.

Checked repo_path, full_name_ok and the host gates (host_ok, host_allowed_reading, config_read), plus the tests that feed gh's config answers, including a shim and a timeout. A top-level gh user is deliberately not a host sign-in, which errs safe; found no provable defect.

Reviewed allowed, local_host/local_ip, hop_ok, the resolver and both icon clients, the saved/system proxy rules, time limits and the update probe. Suspect but could not prove: local_ip does not classify multicast (224/4, ff00::/8) as local; a fetch can only fail to connect there, so no failing test was written.

Read the lookup plan, PR text prompt/parsing, review and reaction arguments, check-link targeting, provider gates and the agent-send path with its tests. parse_pr_text only strips Title:/title: case-sensitively, which is cosmetic for a prompt we write; found no provable defect.

Read porcelain status, remote/github_repo/ssh_host, the gh runners, diff and message helpers, pr_create/prs_poll, merge and stage/commit. R4-F01: github_repo matches the URL scheme only in lowercase, so an uppercase scheme git accepts reads as no repository. Suspect but unproven: ok allows an owner or name of . or .., which github::full_name_ok rejects.

Reviewed remote_id, path_id, root_from, identity, typed_id and host_of_id with the row917/row76 tests. remote_id matches the scheme with eq_ignore_ascii_case, which is the reading github_repo should share (R4-F01); no separate defect found here.

Reviewed ignore answers, matters/counts, Debounce and Schedule, notify parsing, watch/unwatch, the worker and the break/overflow seams with their tests. The debounce, gap and overflow restart logic matched the promises; found no provable defect.

Reviewed invocation and argument limits, the model-help parsers (including the non-ASCII lowercase test), branch slug/placeholder/rename, name_branch and the writer run with its Scratch folder. Found no provable defect.
